import.title: Import from Google Maps
import.step1_desc: Find your route in Google Maps with the start, the destination and any stops you want along the way.
import.step1_tip: You can add up to 9 stops along the way with “Add stop”.
import.step2_desc: Once the route is ready, tap the “Share” button at the bottom of the screen.
import.step2_tip: The share button has the usual share icon (an arrow pointing up).
import.step3_desc: In the menu that appears, pick “Copy link”. The link goes to your clipboard.
import.step3_tip: You can also share straight to GAStroRouteAI if it shows up in the options.
import.step4_desc: Come back to GAStroRouteAI and paste the link. We process the route and add timings, fuel stops and weather automatically.
import.err_bad_link: That link does not look like a Google Maps one.

assistant.title: New AI route
assistant.heading: Tell me what ride you want
assistant.sub: One sentence is enough, for a one-day ride: date, distance, type of road and stops.
assistant.hint: Saturday morning, about 300 km of twisty roads, and a stop for lunch
assistant.example_zone: Saturday morning, 4 hours of twisty roads around {zone}
assistant.example_curves: Saturday morning, 4 hours of twisty roads near home
assistant.example_day: Sunday, 200 km with a stop for lunch
assistant.example_easy: Saturday, something relaxed of 150 km to break in the bike
assistant.manual: I would rather fill it in myself
assistant.more: More options: points of interest, hotels, fuel stops…
assistant.unclear: I did not understand what ride you want. Try saying it another way, or fill it in yourself.
assistant.multi_day: For now I can only do one-day rides. For several days, fill it in yourself.
assistant.l_when_v: Saturday morning · tomorrow at 8 · on the 23rd
assistant.l_how_much_v: 300 km or 4 hours · a morning · a full day
assistant.l_start_v: from a bar, a petrol station or a town
assistant.missing_origin: Where do you set off from? A bar, a petrol station or a town.
assistant.missing_destination: Where are you heading? The route is not a loop.
assistant.missing_departure_time: What time do you set off?
assistant.f_duration: How far I want to ride
assistant.options_loading: Looking for different ways to ride this…
assistant.options_generating: Working out the route you picked…
assistant.options_sketch: Rough line, not the final route
assistant.options_again: None of these, show me others
assistant.options_none: I couldn't find different ways to ride this. You can still generate it.
assistant.direct_roads_why: The short way on back roads. Nearly the same distance as the motorway and it fits in a day.
assistant.direct_fast_why: The quickest, but it is motorway: straight miles and little else. It is here in case you are short on time.
assistant.direct_roads_desc: Direct route on back roads, no stops.
assistant.direct_fast_desc: Direct route by motorway, no stops.
